_why: PREPARATION, the class that does NOT prepare. A bard knows its spells and can cast them all, so class_prepares must stay false, prepared_max 0, and every verse in the book castable. The preparation term in refresh_known_spells reads true for a non-preparing class by construction, so this is the proof that redefining known_<id> left the other three casters alone. int_mod is forced down as in the wizard script to show it makes no difference here.
